## About

Muhammad Subhan Shahid is a freelance web developer and full-stack engineer with 2+ years of professional experience. He also has expertise in Rust backend development, Python machine learning, and UI/UX design with Adobe Photoshop, Canva, and Figma.

He has delivered 6+ projects for 10+ clients with a 100% satisfaction rate. He is currently available for freelance work and full-time opportunities.
